description: Use whenever Kyle hands over a content-series brief or spec (Load-Bearing, FlashFusion blog, any Abstrekkt-lane essay series) and wants it turned into finished, brand-templated, publishable pages. Triggers on "synthesize the series spec", "build out the rest", "build the rest of the posts", "draft the series", "turn the spec into posts", "template the essays", "ship the series", "ship it", "build the Load-Bearing series", "renumber these essays", "make these into standalone pages", or any request to take a multi-post writing plan to shipped HTML. Use even if Kyle only says "continue" or "ship" after a spec exists — a bare terse command mid-series means execute this pipeline. Fires on Load-Bearing / Abstrekkt / FlashFusion content work even when the brand isn't named. NOT for LOXIHART/day-job content, a single post or newsletter issue (use producing-ai-newsletter for a regular issue), or the memoir — those have their own lanes and skills.
